title: Japan 10 Major Electric Utilities 2026 Tiered Residential Tariff Dataset (Juryo Dento A/B) & Electricity Cost Engine
description: Open structured dataset (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM JavaScript engine published by 電気代計算JP (denkidaikeisan.com) covering all 10 major Japanese electric utilities' November 2026 regulated tiered residential tariffs (Juryo Dento A/B), FY2026 renewable energy surcharge (4.18 JPY/kWh), and 31.00 JPY/kWh industry benchmark. Interactive browser tools: wattage calculator (https://denkidaikeisan.com/watt/), appliance scenarios (https://denkidaikeisan.com/kaden/), and 10-utility tariff comparisons (https://denkidaikeisan.com/denryoku/).
